A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the query directed clustering algorithm QDC is the first Web page clustering algorithm that uses the user's search query as part of its cluster quality measure and the first Web page algorithm that uses cluster description similarity in addition to cluster overlap in its cluster merging process.

we have proposed a new Web page cluster quality guide that is based on the relationship between clusters to the query, and we have proposed a clustering algorithm, QDCA, which uses this cluster quality guide.

we developed a new algorithm, QDC that is able to cluster search results into semantical meaningful clusters, and we evaluated it against six other algorithms by using eleven different measures and four different evaluation approaches.
